pullRequests.title: Stop helping the compiler, plus another 1.9% of the game
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
The part everyone will read
Turns out a few of our build steps were doing GCC 2.95's homework for it. Apparently a 25-year-old compiler is supposed to suffer alone, so now it does.
What's gone:

fix_tail_calls.py, fix_trunc_slot.py and fix_core_spills.py, which touched up the compiler's output after the fact.
Per-function flags. GCC 2.95 only takes flags per file, so now we do too (config/file_cflags.txt). Four level functions moved into files of their own to keep theirs. Level files are our…

commits.headline: feat(toolchain): match stuck libgcc modules, add native ee-gcc, and relicense to GPL 3.0
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
- Relicense project under GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- Compile libgcc __moddi3, __udivdi3, and __umoddi3 byte-for-byte matching with Sony 2.9-ee-991111-01
- Fix core_rodata split boundary by separating D_00152F18 from umoddi3 clz_tab
- Support native Linux ee-gcc binary in Makefile.sn when available
- Document native Linux vs Wine environment and Sony 2.96 nop padding heuristic in docs/TOOLCHAIN.md
